body.purpose: Default running text and form values. 18px, the comfortable baseline.

label.purpose: Captions, metadata, tab labels, table headers. The 14px floor of the scale.

shadows.name: shadow-xs

shadows.name: shadow-md
shadows.purpose: The floating TabBar and islands at rest.

shadows.name: shadow-lg

motion.name: control-transition
motion.purpose: Inputs and controls animate color and shadow only, never layout.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The default call to action. Field Green fill, used sparingly under the One Voice Rule.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 8px 36px; border: none; border-radius: 0.7rem; background: var(--primary, oklch(0.6493 0.1841 133.2796)); color: var(--primary-foreground, oklch(0.9857 0.031 120.7572)); font-family: Geologica, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.6493 0.1841 133.2796) 90%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.8426 0.2256 129.6486) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: The quiet alternative to primary. Paper background, hairline border, fills with muted accent on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 8px 36px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.9197 0.004 286.3202); border-radius: 0.7rem; background: oklch(1 0 0); color: oklch(0.1408 0.0044 285.8229); font-family: Geologica, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 500; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 hsl(0 0% 0% / 0.05); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: oklch(0.9674 0.0013 286.3752); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.8426 0.2256 129.6486) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Default field. 40px tall, hairline border, rounded-md (smaller than buttons), focus ring on color + shadow only.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 40px; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.9197 0.004 286.3202); border-radius: 0.4rem; background: oklch(1 0 0); color: oklch(0.1408 0.0044 285.8229); font-family: Geologica, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 hsl(0 0% 0% / 0.05); outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.552 0.0153 285.8863); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: oklch(0.8426 0.2256 129.6486); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.8426 0.2256 129.6486) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat-at-rest container. Hairline border, soft rounded-xl corners, 24px padding rhythm, shadow-sm.
components.html:
Saturday morning shift
3 of 5 volunteers confirmed
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; padding: 24px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.9197 0.004 286.3202); border-radius: 0.7rem; background: oklch(1 0 0); color: oklch(0.1408 0.0044 285.8229); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 hsl(0 0% 0% / 0.1), 0 1px 2px -1px hsl(0 0% 0% / 0.1); font-family: Geologica, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-card-desc { font-size: 0.875rem; color: oklch(0.552 0.0153 285.8863); }

components.name: Success Badge
components.description: Outline-style status badge. Green border with neutral text keeps the One Voice budget intact (no green fill).
components.css: .ds-badge-success { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; width: fit-content; padding: 2px 8px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.6493 0.1841 133.2796); border-radius: 0.5rem; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.1408 0.0044 285.8229); font-family: Geologica, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 400; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: TabBar (active tab)
components.description: Signature floating bottom navigation. Muted pill track with shadow-md; the active tab carries a Field-Green highlight (bg-primary/40) and bold ink label.
components.css: .ds-tabbar { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.9197 0.004 286.3202); border-radius: 9999px; background: oklch(0.9674 0.0013 286.3752); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 hsl(0 0% 0% / 0.1), 0 2px 4px -1px hsl(0 0% 0% / 0.1); font-family: Geologica, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tab { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 2px; width: 96px; height: 64px; padding: 0 16px; border: none; background: transparent; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 400; color: oklch(0.552 0.0153 285.8863); cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab-active { font-weight: 700; color: oklch(0.1408 0.0044 285.8229); } .ds-tab-active::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.6493 0.1841 133.2796) 40%, transparent); } .ds-tab > * { position: relative; z-index: 1; }

narrative.overview: Clippy coordinates volunteers and shifts for organisations, and the interface treats every volunteer as someone who chose to show up rather than someone being processed. The system leads with the person and lets the tooling recede: generous spacing, soft rounded-xl corners, a single warm green that reads as growth and energy. The aesthetic is calm and humane, not clinical. Surfaces are flat at rest and lift only in response. The palette is almost entirely tinted neutral, so the one green carries real weight when it appears.
keyCharacteristics: One warm green, spent sparingly, against tinted-neutral surfaces.
Soft, consistent rounding (rounded-xl on actions and containers).
Comfortable, slightly oversized type. The smallest text is still 14px.
Flat by default; elevation is a response to state, not a baseline.
First-class dark mode, identical token roles to light.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Field Green appears on at most 10% of any screen: the primary button, the active tab, a success badge, a confirmation. Everything else is tinted neutral. The green means something precisely because it is rare.

rules.name: The Tinted-Neutral Rule
rules.body: No pure black, no pure white as text or fill. Every neutral carries the cool ~286 hue at trace chroma.

rules.name: The 14px Floor Rule
rules.body: Nothing renders below 14px. What other systems call text-xs is 14px here, not 12px.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Geologica does the work alone in-app. Reach for Merriweather only for long-form prose, and Source Code Pro only for machine values.

rules.name: The Upsizing Rule
rules.body: The base shadcn type scale is bumped one step (text-xs..text-4xl redefined) for legibility, with no markup changes. Standalone primary buttons also move to the lg size.

rules.name: The Weight Rebalancing Rule
rules.body: When text grows, weight rebalances: headings and labels gain weight (section heading 600->700, label 500->600); dense repeated content sheds it (table cell 500->400, badge 600->400).

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: A surface earns a shadow only by floating or by responding to state. Static in-flow content uses a hairline border, never a shadow.

dos: Do keep Field Green to <=10% of any screen (the One Voice Rule). Reserve it for the primary action, the active state, and success.
Do tint every neutral toward the cool ~286 hue. Use the OKLCH tokens; never hardcode #000 or #fff.
Do keep body text at 18px and never go below the 14px floor.
Do rebalance weight when text scales: headings and labels gain weight (section heading to Bold 700, label to SemiBold 600); table cells and badges shed it to Regular 400.
Do reserve the lg button size for standalone primary actions; keep toolbar, filter, and secondary controls at the smaller md size.
Do use rounded-xl for buttons and cards, rounded-md for inputs, and rounded-full for the tab-bar.
Do start surfaces flat. Add a shadow only when an element floats or responds to state.
Do drive focus, error, and active states through ARIA and the token-bound ring, so light and dark stay in sync.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion: motion must snap instantly when reduced.
donts: Don't use green as decoration, tint backgrounds with it, or let a screen look green. Rarity is the point.
Don't introduce a second accent hue. Status meaning lives in green (success) and Danger (error) only.
Don't drop below 14px or revert to a tight 12/13px enterprise-admin scale.
Don't mix type families for emphasis; hierarchy comes from Geologica's scale and weight.
Don't put shadows on static in-flow content; separate with a hairline border instead.
Don't use a border-left/border-right colored stripe as an accent on cards, list items, or alerts.
Don't add bounce or elastic easing. New motion should ease out and resolve.
Don't drift toward either failure mode: clinical zebra-grid enterprise admin, or bouncy mascot-and-gradient consumer.
